description: One feed for every symbol on Binance's USDⓈ-M perpetual futures: every liquidation on the exchange, and optionally every symbol's mark price and funding. No keys, no symbols to pick. Files go to the lake under raw/binance/usdm/<instance>/ALL/<stream>, gzipped when the UTC day closes, with a ledger of every gap.

streams.title: Market-wide streams

x-labels.markPrice@arr: Every symbol's mark price and funding

streams.x-note: Sizes gzipped, measured from oryx on 2026-10-27 over 60 s. Mark price for every symbol is about 5 GB a day uncompressed until its day closes.
